```{r}
# DSS uses count data, so convert methylation proportion * N into methylated count X.
# The N >= 5 filter matches the earlier script, although DSS can incorporate
# coverage depth directly.

read_methylc_for_dss <- function(path, method, min_coverage = 5) {
  df <- fread(path)

  if (method == "pg") {
    colnames(df) <- c("chr", "pos", "stop", "context", "methylation", "Strand", "N", "Flag", "Segment", "Offset")
  } else if (method == "Yu") {
    colnames(df) <- c("chr", "pos", "stop", "context", "methylation", "Strand", "N")
  } else {
    stop("Unknown method: ", method)
  }

  df$N <- as.integer(df$N)
  df$methylation <- as.numeric(df$methylation)

  df$X <- as.integer(round(df$methylation * df$N))

  df$X[df$X < 0] <- 0
  df$X[df$X > df$N] <- df$N[df$X > df$N]

  df <- df %>%
    select(chr, pos, N, X) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chr), !is.na(pos), !is.na(N), !is.na(X)) %>%
    filter(N >= min_coverage)

  df <- as.data.table(df)
  setorder(df, chr, pos)

  return(as.data.frame(df))
}
```

```{r}
df_list <- vector("list", length = nrow(manifest))
```

```{r}
L_shared["CAST_pg", 1] <- 1

L_method_by_strain <- matrix(

standardize_dss_multifactor_test <- function(x) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  nm <- colnames(x)

  chr_col  <- intersect(c("chr", "seqnames"), nm)
  pos_col  <- intersect(c("pos", "start"), nm)
  stat_col <- intersect(c("stat", "stats", "wald", "fstat"), nm)
  p_col    <- intersect(c("pvals", "pval", "PVAL", "p.value"), nm)
  fdr_col  <- intersect(c("fdrs", "fdr", "FDR", "adj.p"), nm)

  if (length(chr_col) == 0)  stop("Could not find chromosome column in DSS result.")
  if (length(pos_col) == 0)  stop("Could not find position column in DSS result.")
  if (length(stat_col) == 0) stop("Could not find statistic column in DSS result.")
  if (length(p_col) == 0)    stop("Could not find p-value column in DSS result.")
  if (length(fdr_col) == 0)  stop("Could not find FDR column in DSS result.")

  chr_col  <- chr_col[1]
  pos_col  <- pos_col[1]
  stat_col <- stat_col[1]
  p_col    <- p_col[1]
  fdr_col  <- fdr_col[1]

  y <- data.frame(
    chr   = as.character(x[[chr_col]]),
    pos   = as.integer(x[[pos_col]]),
    stat  = as.numeric(x[[stat_col]]),
    pvals = as.numeric(x[[p_col]]),
    fdrs  = as.numeric(x[[fdr_col]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # add aliases because different DSS code paths have historically used both styles
  y$pval <- y$pvals
  y$fdr  <- y$fdrs

  y <- y[!is.na(y$chr) & !is.na(y$pos) & !is.na(y$stat) & !is.na(y$pvals), , drop = FALSE]
  y <- y[order(y$chr, y$pos), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(y) <- NULL

  return(y)
}

extract_dml_from_multifactor <- function(x, p.threshold) {
  y <- x[x$pvals < p.threshold, c("chr", "pos", "stat", "pvals", "fdrs"), drop = FALSE]
  y <- y[order(y$pvals, -abs(y$stat), y$chr, y$pos), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(y) <- NULL
  return(y)
}

make_dmr_gr <- function(dmrs_df, prefix) {
  if (nrow(dmrs_df) == 0) {
    return(GRanges())
  }

  gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = dmrs_df$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(start = dmrs_df$start, end = dmrs_df$end)
  )

  mcols(gr)$dmr_id <- paste0(prefix, seq_len(nrow(dmrs_df)))
  mcols(gr)$areaStat <- dmrs_df$areaStat
  mcols(gr)$sign <- sign(dmrs_df$areaStat)

  return(gr)
}

classify_dmr_overlap <- function(dmrs_a, dmrs_b, prefix_a, prefix_b) {
  gr_a <- make_dmr_gr(dmrs_a, prefix_a)
  gr_b <- make_dmr_gr(dmrs_b, prefix_b)

  if (length(gr_a) == 0) {
    out_a <- data.frame()
  } else {
    out_a <- as.data.frame(dmrs_a)
    out_a$classification <- "only_in_A"
    out_a$overlap_partner <- NA_character_
  }

  if (length(gr_b) == 0) {
    out_b <- data.frame()
  } else {
    out_b <- as.data.frame(dmrs_b)
    out_b$classification <- "only_in_B"
    out_b$overlap_partner <- NA_character_
  }

  if (length(gr_a) == 0 || length(gr_b) == 0) {
    return(list(A = out_a, B = out_b))
  }

  hits <- findOverlaps(gr_a, gr_b)

  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    return(list(A = out_a, B = out_b))
  }

  hit_df <- data.frame(
    a = queryHits(hits),
    b = subjectHits(hits),
    same_sign = mcols(gr_a)$sign[queryHits(hits)] == mcols(gr_b)$sign[subjectHits(hits)],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (i in unique(hit_df$a)) {
    sub <- hit_df[hit_df$a == i, , drop = FALSE]
    partners <- paste(mcols(gr_b)$dmr_id[sub$b], collapse = ",")
    out_a$overlap_partner[i] <- partners

    if (any(sub$same_sign)) {
      out_a$classification[i] <- "shared_overlap_same_direction"
    } else {
      out_a$classification[i] <- "shared_overlap_opposite_direction"
    }
  }

  for (j in unique(hit_df$b)) {
    sub <- hit_df[hit_df$b == j, , drop = FALSE]
    partners <- paste(mcols(gr_a)$dmr_id[sub$a], collapse = ",")
    out_b$overlap_partner[j] <- partners

    if (any(sub$same_sign)) {
      out_b$classification[j] <- "shared_overlap_same_direction"
    } else {
      out_b$classification[j] <- "shared_overlap_opposite_direction"
    }
  }

  return(list(A = out_a, B = out_b))
}

# Standardize only the two successful coef-based multifactor test objects
dmlTest_BL6_method  <- standardize_dss_multifactor_test(dmlTest_BL6_method)
dmlTest_CAST_method <- standardize_dss_multifactor_test(dmlTest_CAST_method)

fwrite(dmlTest_BL6_method,  "Results/multifactor/dmlTest_BL6_method.standardized.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")
fwrite(dmlTest_CAST_method, "Results/multifactor/dmlTest_CAST_method.standardized.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")

saveRDS(dmlTest_BL6_method,  "Results/multifactor/dmlTest_BL6_method.standardized.rds")
saveRDS(dmlTest_CAST_method, "Results/multifactor/dmlTest_CAST_method.standardized.rds")

# DMLs: manual extraction, not callDML()
dmls_BL6_method <- extract_dml_from_multifactor(
  dmlTest_BL6_method,
  p.threshold = p_threshold_dml_multifactor
)

dmls_CAST_method <- extract_dml_from_multifactor(
  dmlTest_CAST_method,
  p.threshold = p_threshold_dml_multifactor
)

fwrite(dmls_BL6_method,  "Results/multifactor/dmls_BL6_method.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")
fwrite(dmls_CAST_method, "Results/multifactor/dmls_CAST_method.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")

# DMRs: callDMR() on standardized coef-based multifactor test results
dmrs_BL6_method <- callDMR(
  dmlTest_BL6_method,
  delta = 0,
  p.threshold = p_threshold_dmr_multifactor
)

dmrs_CAST_method <- callDMR(
  dmlTest_CAST_method,
  delta = 0,
  p.threshold = p_threshold_dmr_multifactor
)

if (is.null(dmrs_BL6_method)) dmrs_BL6_method <- data.frame()
if (is.null(dmrs_CAST_method)) dmrs_CAST_method <- data.frame()

fwrite(dmrs_BL6_method,  "Results/multifactor/dmrs_BL6_method.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")
fwrite(dmrs_CAST_method, "Results/multifactor/dmrs_CAST_method.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")

# DML-level shared vs strain-specific classification
dml_merge <- merge(
  dmlTest_BL6_method[, c("chr", "pos", "stat", "pvals", "fdrs")],
  dmlTest_CAST_method[, c("chr", "pos", "stat", "pvals", "fdrs")],
  by = c("chr", "pos"),
  suffixes = c(".BL6", ".CAST"),
  all = FALSE
)

dml_merge$BL6_sig  <- !is.na(dml_merge$pvals.BL6)  & dml_merge$pvals.BL6  < p_threshold_dml_multifactor
dml_merge$CAST_sig <- !is.na(dml_merge$pvals.CAST) & dml_merge$pvals.CAST < p_threshold_dml_multifactor
dml_merge$same_direction <- sign(dml_merge$stat.BL6) == sign(dml_merge$stat.CAST)

dml_merge$classification <- "not_significant"
dml_merge$classification[dml_merge$BL6_sig & !dml_merge$CAST_sig] <- "BL6_only"
dml_merge$classification[!dml_merge$BL6_sig & dml_merge$CAST_sig] <- "CAST_only"
dml_merge$classification[dml_merge$BL6_sig & dml_merge$CAST_sig & dml_merge$same_direction] <- "shared_same_direction"
dml_merge$classification[dml_merge$BL6_sig & dml_merge$CAST_sig & !dml_merge$same_direction] <- "shared_opposite_direction"

fwrite(dml_merge, "Results/multifactor/dml_site_classification_BL6_vs_CAST.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")

# DMR-level shared vs strain-specific classification by overlap
dmr_class <- classify_dmr_overlap(
  dmrs_a = dmrs_BL6_method,
  dmrs_b = dmrs_CAST_method,
  prefix_a = "BL6_",
  prefix_b = "CAST_"
)

dmrs_BL6_classified <- dmr_class$A
dmrs_CAST_classified <- dmr_class$B

fwrite(dmrs_BL6_classified,  "Results/multifactor/dmrs_BL6_method.classified.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")
fwrite(dmrs_CAST_classified, "Results/multifactor/dmrs_CAST_method.classified.tsv.gz", sep = "\t")

summary_counts <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "BL6_method_DMLs",
    "CAST_method_DMLs",
    "BL6_method_DMRs",
    "CAST_method_DMRs",
    "DML_shared_same_direction",
    "DML_shared_opposite_direction",
    "DML_BL6_only",
    "DML_CAST_only",
    "DMR_BL6_shared_same_direction",
    "DMR_BL6_shared_opposite_direction",
    "DMR_BL6_only",
    "DMR_CAST_shared_same_direction",
    "DMR_CAST_shared_opposite_direction",
    "DMR_CAST_only"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(dmls_BL6_method),
    nrow(dmls_CAST_method),
    nrow(dmrs_BL6_method),
    nrow(dmrs_CAST_method),
    sum(dml_merge$classification == "shared_same_direction"),
    sum(dml_merge$classification == "shared_opposite_direction"),
    sum(dml_merge$classification == "BL6_only"),
    sum(dml_merge$classification == "CAST_only"),
    if (nrow(dmrs_BL6_classified) == 0) 0 else sum(dmrs_BL6_classified$classification == "shared_overlap_same_direction"),
    if (nrow(dmrs_BL6_classified) == 0) 0 else sum(dmrs_BL6_classified$classification == "shared_overlap_opposite_direction"),
    if (nrow(dmrs_BL6_classified) == 0) 0 else sum(dmrs_BL6_classified$classification == "only_in_A"),
    if (nrow(dmrs_CAST_classified) == 0) 0 else sum(dmrs_CAST_classified$classification == "shared_overlap_same_direction"),
    if (nrow(dmrs_CAST_classified) == 0) 0 else sum(dmrs_CAST_classified$classification == "shared_overlap_opposite_direction"),
    if (nrow(dmrs_CAST_classified) == 0) 0 else sum(dmrs_CAST_classified$classification == "only_in_B")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print(summary_counts)
fwrite(summary_counts, "Results/multifactor/summary_counts.BL6_vs_CAST_coef_based.tsv", sep = "\t")
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
volcano_df <- bind_rows(
  dml_merge %>%
    transmute(
      strain = "BL6",
      chr = chr,
      pos = pos,
      stat = stat.BL6,
      pvals = pvals.BL6,
      classification = case_when(
        classification == "BL6_only" ~ "strain_only",
        classification == "shared_same_direction" ~ "shared_same_direction",
        classification == "shared_opposite_direction" ~ "shared_opposite_direction",
        TRUE ~ "not_significant"
      )
    ),
  dml_merge %>%
    transmute(
      strain = "CAST",
      chr = chr,
      pos = pos,
      stat = stat.CAST,
      pvals = pvals.CAST,
      classification = case_when(
        classification == "CAST_only" ~ "strain_only",
        classification == "shared_same_direction" ~ "shared_same_direction",
        classification == "shared_opposite_direction" ~ "shared_opposite_direction",
        TRUE ~ "not_significant"
      )
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10p = -log10(pvals),
    classification = factor(
      classification,
      levels = c(
        "not_significant",
        "strain_only",
        "shared_same_direction",
        "shared_opposite_direction"
      )
    )
  )

p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = stat, y = neglog10p, color = classification)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_threshold_dml_multifactor), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ strain, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "DML volcano",
    x = "Wald stat",
    y = "-log10(p)"
  )

p_volcano

ggsave(
  "Figures/DML_volcano_by_strain.pdf",
  p_volcano,
  width = 4,
  height = 4
)
```

```{r}
cast_only_dml_bed <- cast_only_dml %>%
  transmute(
    chr = chr,
    start = pos - 1L,
    end = pos,
    name = paste0(
      "CAST_only_DML;",
      "BL6_p=", signif(pvals.BL6, 3), ";",
      "CAST_p=", signif(pvals.CAST, 3), ";",
      "BL6_stat=", signif(stat.BL6, 4), ";",
      "CAST_stat=", signif(stat.CAST, 4)
    ),
    score = pmin(1000L, as.integer(round(-log10(pvals.CAST) * 100))),
    strand = "."
  )

cast_only_dmr_bed <- cast_only_dmr %>%
  transmute(
    chr = chr,
    start = start,
    end = end,
    name = paste0(
      "CAST_only_DMR;",
      "nCG=", nCG, ";",
      "length=", length, ";",
      "areaStat=", signif(areaStat, 4)
    ),
    score = pmin(1000L, as.integer(round(abs(areaStat)))),
    strand = "."
  )

fwrite(
  cast_only_dml_bed,
  "Results/multifactor/CAST_only_DMLs.browser.bed",
  sep = "\t",
  col.names = FALSE
)

fwrite(
  cast_only_dmr_bed,
  "Results/multifactor/CAST_only_DMRs.browser.bed",
  sep = "\t",
  col.names = FALSE
)

cat("CAST-only DMLs:", nrow(cast_only_dml), "\n")
cat("CAST-only DMRs:", nrow(cast_only_dmr), "\n")

head(cast_only_dml)
head(cast_only_dmr)
```
